name: Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz - § 51 - Am 3
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 51. Regrets that the chapter on TSD is not subject to the general state-to-state dispute settlement mechanism and therefore the provisions dealing with the protection of the environment and workers’ rights are not enforceable; further regrets that the Paris Agreement is not an essential element of the Modernised Global Agreement; calls for the parties, as part of the TSD review, to include the Paris Agreement and ILO core conventions as essential elements of the Agreement and to make the TSD chapter subject to the general state-to-state dispute settlement mechanism of the Agreement;
